reason: A mobile and tablet responsive-layout plugin for DSH Web UI, with drawer and bottom-sheet navigation, safe-area handling, narrow-screen input layout adjustments, and optional diagnostics.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供手机和平板响应式适配，包括抽屉导航、底部浮层、安全区处理和窄屏输入布局优化。
summaries.en: Provides responsive mobile and tablet adaptations for the DSH Web UI, including drawer navigation, bottom sheets, safe-area handling, and narrow-screen input layout improvements.

capabilities: Adapts the DSH Web UI for narrow screens and tablets
Changes sidebar, dialogs, previews, and input-area layouts for touch use
Provides an optional mobile navigation diagnostic overlay
